title: 恐龙的名字是怎么来的 · 素材

style: children's picture book illustration, fine pen lines with light watercolour washes laid over them, ink blue, warm sand and terracotta

pages.scene: One single triceratops standing on four legs, seen from the side facing left, three horns on its face and a broad bony frill behind its head, its whole body inside the picture. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges. The object floats on this flat colour: it casts no shadow and rests on no ground, and there is no darker patch, wash, puddle, base, line or platform of any kind underneath it. There is no sky, no horizon, no clouds and no scenery of any kind behind it: the cream colour is the only thing behind the object, exactly as if the object had been cut out and laid on blank paper.
